target: forge.sh push — ssh remotes and github/none kinds are a plain git push -u <remote> <branch> with no GIT_CONFIG injection
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote git@gitlab.example.test:grp/proj.git
TOK=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
p() { fx_reqs_clear; fx_run push main; echo "$1: $(tail -1 "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/git-push.log" 2>/dev/null)"; }
export FORGE_TOKEN=$TOK
p ssh-gitlab
unset FORGE_TOKEN; fx_setremote https://github.com/o/r.git; p https-github
export FORGE_TOKEN=$TOK; p https-github-token
fx_setremote https://git.example.test/o/r.git; p none-token
fx_setremote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git; export FORGE=none; p declared-none-token
fx_done

strings: ssh-gitlab: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0 keys= value_has_token=no args=-u origin main
https-github: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0 keys= value_has_token=no args=-u origin main
https-github-token: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0 keys= value_has_token=no args=-u origin main
none-token: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0 keys= value_has_token=no args=-u origin main
declared-none-token: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0 keys= value_has_token=no args=-u origin main
